tasks.title: W7 checkout to wallet credit map
tasks.prompt:
# MISSAO
Read-only W7 finance analysis. Map exactly how a paid checkout order currently creates sale records and whether it credits `KloelWallet`/wallet ledger. Identify the smallest idempotent patch and test target.

# ARQUIVOS PERMITIDOS
backend/src/checkout/**, backend/src/webhooks/payment-webhook-stripe.handlers2.ts, backend/src/webhooks/payment-webhook-stripe.handlers2.helpers.ts, backend/src/webhooks/payment-webhook-generic.helpers.ts, backend/src/kloel/wallet*.ts, backend/src/kloel/payment.service.ts, backend/src/kloel/smart-payment.service.ts, backend/prisma/schema.prisma, docs/implementation/**

# ARQUIVOS PROIBIDOS
All files outside ARQUIVOS PERMITIDOS. Do not edit anything. Do not read .env files. Do not print secrets. Do not run migrations. Do not run destructive DB commands.

# PRE-LEITURA OBRIGATORIA
AGENTS.md, docs/implementation/kloel-cia-gap-inventory.md, docs/implementation/kloel-cia-evidence-ledger.md, docs/implementation/kloel-cia-session-handoff.md.

# COMPORTAMENTO ESPERADO
No code changes. Produce file:line evidence for the checkout paid path, wallet credit path, idempotency surface, and missing edge tests.

# COMANDOS DE VALIDACAO PERMITIDOS
rg, sed, git diff --stat. No tests, no package install, no network, no git writes.

# CRITERIO DE SUCESSO
Report names the exact function to patch, the exact model fields to use for idempotency, and the focused Jest test file to add/extend.

# CRITERIO DE FALHA
Any file edit, secret output, fake production claim, or recommendation without file:line evidence.

# FORMATO DE RELATORIO
- checkout paid path map
- wallet credit/idempotency map
- smallest patch recommendation
- test recommendation
- risks/remediation

# REGRAS DE SEGURANCA
Never print env values or secrets. Never use git reset/restore/clean/push. Redact tokens/keys if seen.

# REGRA DE CONFLITO
If repo evidence contradicts this prompt, stop and report the contradiction.
